scope: Local macOS, same user; setup by default, full source-bound C01 T01 only with --profile c01
transport: local files; no MCP, HTTP, socket or network listener
discovery: One agent_setup.json descriptor per native runner session

request.publication: Publish complete JSON atomically without replacing an existing request ID

native_core_contract: NativeRoute.call(operation, arguments, caller) -> result/error plus actual attempt receipt
reply: replies/<request_id>.json; matching route/request IDs and submitted request digest
custody: Receipt digest checked against native process memory
interruption: Never automatically replay claimed calls. A client timeout is incomplete evidence, not cancellation or permission to repeat. Inspect retained evidence and start a new session if the runner was interrupted.
extension_rule: Additional system adapters implement the same native call/result contract without changing ABI semantics, policy, source/authority binding or shared clearance rules.
trust: Same-user local integrity and provenance; not protection against a process able to rewrite the checkout. Agent labels are self-reported, not authentication.
qualification_limits: Session 304 qualifies the earlier setup route only; each extension requires fresh proof
One operation per client invocation; operator chooses steps and audits actual results
C01 contour oracle only after construction
No global configuration, installation or new permissions

optional_profiles.setup: Existing four setup operations only; default
